purpose: Bounded read-only source triage for the seven still-unsupported 2026 Senate settings requested. Existing evidence is pinned; no source admission or input/model changes are proposed.

states.original_evidence: Official indexed mixed candidate page has two United States Senator rows marked Certified, but direct page response and section/election binding were not authenticated. This supports two leads only; not admitted eligibility or closure.
states.proposed_claim: After the official Oct. 29, 2026 5 p.m. Alaska-time write-in filing deadline, retrieve the official election candidates source and bind the complete Senate rows to the 2026 general election, including write-in status. The deadline is still future as of this triage.
states.next_action_that_changes_evidence: On/after Oct. 29, reacquire original official candidates response and official 2026 candidate calendar; preserve event/section identifiers, full Senate result scope, status and retrieval time.

states.original_evidence: Indexed official general ElectionID 71 table reportedly has Write-In and status columns, three active printed Senate rows, and Tyrone Muhammad marked Removed. Direct request returned 403; neither county declaration coverage nor statewide write-in completeness is established.

original_source_pins.note: Official Illinois State Board of Elections site; ElectionID 71 general table is referenced in prior indexed evidence, but exact direct request URL/client parameters were not authenticated in reviewed local records.

states.proposed_claim: A shell/network retrieval of the official State Board of Elections ElectionID 71 general-election table is a concrete next attempt, but the direct URL and request parameters must be recovered from the official client first. The current indexed table may establish only what that table covers; county filing and write-in completeness still need explicit source documentation.
states.next_action_that_changes_evidence: Retrieve the official page/client and recover the ElectionID 71 request parameters, then fetch and save original response bytes through a working shell network with request and scope metadata. Do not treat blank write-in cells as zero.

states.original_evidence: Current statute and county notice establish a fourth-Monday deadline. Clarification resolves the 2026 date as Oct. 12 (not Oct. 5); deadline passage does not prove zero declarations. Johnson/Sedgwick current ordinary candidate pages are not a complete write-in list.
states.proposed_claim: The missing evidence is a post-deadline official SOS Senate affidavit/certification list or a county notice explicitly reproducing the complete statewide federal list. No zero-write-in claim is supported.
states.next_action_that_changes_evidence: Attempt retrieval of the official SOS Senate affidavit/certification payload after the Oct. 12 deadline using the official linked client/page and a working shell network; record the complete scope and original bytes.

states.original_evidence: Official state GEN2026 working report has six retained Senate nominees; Macomb Sep. 3 and Wayne Sep. 10 lists predate the Oct. 23 deadline. The state report has no Write entries and no declaration-type coverage statement. A current report page exists, but its coverage cannot be inferred from blank rows.

original_source_pins.use: Official Oct. 23 4 p.m. deadline guide; rule only, not a declaration list.

states.proposed_claim: Current state report semantics and complete post-deadline declaration coverage remain unresolved. A report payload alone changes evidence only if its fields/documentation establish write-in declaration inclusion.
states.next_action_that_changes_evidence: Find the post-Oct. 23 BOE or county federal declaration list with an explicit coverage description, or the state report's original payload/schema documentation establishing write-in coverage.

states.original_evidence: Current MCA 13-10-211 sets the ordinary deadline 90 days before the election and permits late declarations only where, after that deadline, an opposing candidate dies or is charged with a felony. The official filing lead has Jami Dee Woodman filed Aug. 7, after the Aug. 5 ordinary deadline; no qualifying exception/adjudication is acquired. Four printed people remain retained; Woodman stays held.

original_source_pins.use: Official Federal General 2026 candidate list; portal record is a filing lead, not proof of qualification.

states.proposed_claim: Resolving Woodman's eligible write-in status requires the official exception basis and filing/acceptance adjudication, or a definitive official Senate qualified-write-in record. A late FILED label alone is insufficient.
states.next_action_that_changes_evidence: Retrieve the official filing record/status and any official notice applying the statutory exception to the Senate contest; preserve the exact decision language and its source.

states.original_evidence: The official Sep. 11 statewide general candidate filing list predates the Oct. 23 write-in deadline. A Douglas County notice is explicitly for candidates appearing on the general ballot and does not cover write-in affidavits. Five Senate names remain preserved; no absence inference is supported.

original_source_pins.note: Official SOS elections landing page; exact post-deadline candidate-list payload/page is not pinned in reviewed evidence.

states.proposed_claim: The next potentially informative evidence is an updated post-Oct. 23 statewide qualified write-in list or a source explicitly certifying complete Senate write-in coverage. Its publication date is not established.
states.next_action_that_changes_evidence: Recheck the official SOS candidate filing page for a post-deadline list and retrieve original bytes plus election/office/status scope; do not use ordinary candidate notices to close write-in support.

states.original_evidence: Official Nashville rule confirms a timely certificate requirement and excludes same-office primary losers, but is not a 2026 named roster. Accessible ordinary candidate lists do not establish qualified write-in coverage; prior state/alternate-county URLs were inaccessible.
states.proposed_claim: The specific county/Coordinator source that holds a complete 2026 federal write-in certificate list is not established from reviewed evidence; do not project Nashville's rule page into a statewide roster.
states.next_action_that_changes_evidence: Locate an official Tennessee Coordinator of Elections or county source explicitly listing qualified Nov. 3, 2026 U.S. Senate write-in certificates and complete statewide/county scope; fetch original source and its rule/date metadata.

explicit_limits: State facts above summarize retrieved official-source evidence as represented in the pinned local records; rendered/indexed captures are not original server bytes unless stated.
Proposed claims and next actions are research directions, not newly verified candidate claims.
No statement that an unnamed or absent write-in equals zero.
No owner/admission/model changes; no runtime, scorer, or fit work.
